controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Voyager 2 clear-filter imagery registered to the PDS Stooke shape. Measured sky-background subtraction and bounded illumination correction reduce photographed shading. Gray grid marks unavailable or unreliable samples. The distant hemisphere and cast shadows are not reconstructed. Fine grain is largely source-image noise and must not be interpreted as resolved terrain.

controls.summary: Voyager 2 images mapped onto the shape with adjusted brightness. Gray grid: missing or unreliable data.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 208 km reference sphere from Stooke’s Voyager-derived shape model. Shows the broad irregular shape, not local height above a geoid. The archived 5° radius grid includes modeled unseen terrain and can exaggerate facets or depressions. Small craters are not resolved.
